segments.comment: A debug Valkyrie level-teleports to D:3, creates a long worm (makemon gives it tail segments), searches once and dies to a wished wand of death, saving bones. save.c savelev_core() writes the worm's segments with worm.c save_worm().

A Samurai loads the bones on D:3. restore.c getlev() reads the segments back with rest_worm() and places them with place_wsegs(), so after a teleport into the worm's room its tail shows as '~' beside its head.
